title: 무역보험법 시행규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00001:20080303:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDA (Enforcement Rules of the Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of Knowledge Economy and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Rule No. 1, Mar. 3, 2008>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.

Articles 2 through 4 Omitted.

Article 5 (Amendments to Other Statutes)
(1) through (26) Omitted.

(27) The Enforcement Rules of the Export Insurance Act are partially amended as follows:

The term "Minister of Commerce, Industry and Energy" in Article 2 (1) and (2), Article 3, Article 4, and Article 5 is replaced with "Minister of Knowledge Economy", respectively.

In Article 4, "Article 98 of the Insurance Business Act" is replaced with "Article 120 of the Insurance Business Act".

(28) through (64) Omitted.
